'''Rossum Droidworks''' (R.D.W.) was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-manufacturing company created and owned by [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] following his departure from the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. He bought [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] and similar droids, whereupon he created R.D.W. in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], where he sold them. This made him very wealthy.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the company was a major client of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commandant]] [[Milosh Muhrlein]], where they were working on a secret project designated [[Iron Eclipse]]. In this time, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Jahan Cross]] discovered the link between Muhrlein and R.D.W., whereupon he departed to the Corporate Sector to uncover more about the Iron Eclipse project.
